title: Avocado Wrap
description: A simple and delicious wrap filled with mashed avocado and pan-fried to perfection. Serve immediately and enjoy!
instructions: 1. Cut the avocado in half and remove the pit.
2. Mash the avocado in a bowl with a fork until it reaches your desired consistency.
3. Heat a small amount of oil in the pan over medium heat.
4. Place the tortilla wrap in the pan and cook for 30 seconds on each side.
5. Fill the tortilla wrap with the mashed avocado and fold it in half to enclose.
6. Cook the wrap for an additional 30 seconds to melt the avocado slightly.
7. Remove the wrap from the pan and serve immediately.
